candidates.change_summary: Change the required deposit from 1 ether to 2 ether.
Record block.number instead of block.number + 1 as the target block.
Record block.number + 2 instead of block.number + 1 as the target block.
Store the bitwise complement of the hash instead of the hash itself.
Remove the guard that prevents overwriting an existing guess, allowing repeated lock-ins to change stored state.
Delete the payout transfer so winners never receive 2 ether.
Delete the reset of guesses[msg.sender].block so the guess is never cleared, permanently blocking new lockInGuess calls.
Change the payout amount from 2 ether to 1 ether so winners receive a different amount.
Delete the requirement that the target block has passed so settle can be called before the target block, resetting the guess without any payout.
Remove the answer != 0 check so a zero hash can win the payout when the target block hash is unavailable.
Compute the answer from the current block number instead of the locked-in target block, so the answer is always zero and nobody can win.
